title: Domain message envelope
description: The common envelope every uTrace domain message carries. Envelope and payload have independent positive major versions. Every producer and consumer runtime-validates both. Optional values are omitted, never null.

message_id.description: Identity of this message. Events and Results deduplicate by it; Commands deduplicate by domain_ids.command_id.

envelope_version.description: Major version of this envelope contract. Removed, renamed, newly required, or semantically changed fields require a new major.

family.description: Event is an immutable past-tense fact, Command is one immutable single-purpose request, Result is accepted, progress, or one canonical terminal outcome for a Command.

payload_type.description: Area-namespaced payload name, for example product_signal.created. Selects the payload schema document.

payload_version.description: Major version of the payload contract, independent of envelope_version.

producer.description: The software that emitted the message, distinct from the actor it acted for.

actor.description: Who or what the producer acted for. Omitted for messages with no actor. Model roles never impersonate a person whose evidence informed their proposal.

client_scope.description: Tenant scope. One client must never see another client's records.

domain_ids.description: Typed domain identifiers establishing the message's explicit relationships.

authority.description: The pinned records this message relies on for authority. Knowledge of an identifier grants nothing; the control plane rechecks each reference.

causation.description: Message lineage preserved through historical replay.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened or the request was created, as stated by the producer. Producer timestamps never decide workflow order.

recorded_at.description: When the control plane accepted the message. Assigned on acceptance, so it is absent on the producing side.

trace_context.description: W3C trace context describing technical execution only. It is never product identity or permission.

stream.description: The primary lifecycle stream this message belongs to, its expected revision, and the sequence the control plane assigns after acceptance.

payload.description: The payload described by payload_type and payload_version. Area schemas constrain it.
payload.$comment: extension-point: the area schema named by payload_type constrains this object.

digest.description: Digest of the payload, computed identically in every binding.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with a literal Z offset.

producer.description: The emitting runtime. Client-installed extension and SDK components advertise their contract versions during authenticated readiness.

component.description: Deployed component name, for example control_plane_api, telemetry_worker, browser_sdk.

component_version.description: Build or release identity of the component.

instance_id.description: Process or task instance, for operational diagnosis only.

client_scope.description: Either one client tenant or the platform itself. Platform scope carries no client records.

authority_reference.description: One pinned authority record. A Product Signal pins its configuration release; a gate approval freezes scope; only an active fenced Environment Lease grants workspace mutation.

revision.description: The revision this message was built against. A mismatch rejects before side effects.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic lease fencing token. Stale tokens are rejected before the provider call and again when the Result returns.

causation.description: Lineage only. Causation never confers authority and never substitutes for a typed domain identifier.

trace_context.description: W3C trace context. The traceparent version is 00 and neither the trace ID nor the parent ID may be all zeros.

stream_position.description: Position in one primary lifecycle stream. Job, Job Run, and Command are execution lifecycles, never product outcomes.

expected_revision.description: Declared by state-sensitive messages. A mismatch rejects before side effects.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence the control plane assigns within the stream after acceptance. Absent on the producing side.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme form of the payload, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.
